status: exploratory three-stage follow-up; all designs frozen before new model results
data: same pinned 25 cotrain policies, 50 tasks, 17 ancestry proxies
outer: original 3 group folds x 3 partitions x 5 anchor orders; never compare policies across held-out folds
subsets: first three nested group orders from the preceding learning curve; retain all configurations in selected groups
primary_endpoint: full training pool, 10 anchors, all 40 nonanchor tasks; score MAE and material-gap task-macro ranking error
controlled_scaling_endpoint: the last 30 tasks of each seeded task order, identical at all anchor budgets and training fractions

stage1.capacity: effective rank capped by centered training-matrix numerical rank; requested and effective ranks recorded
stage1.selection: inner grouped CV family-macro MAE on all nonanchor tasks; ascending rank then descending ridge tie break

stage2.model: clip means to [0.01,0.99], transform to logits, learn task basis by centered SVD, ridge-infer policy coordinates from logit anchors, apply sigmoid
stage2.selection: inner grouped CV family-macro probability-space MAE
stage2.limit: a bounded nonlinear prediction rule with logit-space squared-error factor fitting; not joint optimization of probability-space likelihood

stage3.utility: mean(anchor scores) plus a learned linear correction from centered anchors; shared correction for RankGlobal, separate per task for RankTask
stage3.loss: pairwise logistic loss for training policy pairs from different groups with observed success gaps >=0.10; fixed temperature 0.10; L2 shrink correction toward zero
stage3.pair_weights: inverse product of policy counts in the two groups, then normalize within each task
stage3.selection: inner jointly held-out cross-family pairs only; pool disjoint folds then task-macro ranking error; ties prefer more shrinkage
stage3.small_sample_rule: if inner folds contain no eligible cross-family comparisons, select the anchor-only baseline and flag selection as unavailable
stage3.output: uncalibrated utilities used only for ranking; do not present utility MAE as success-rate prediction error

uncertainty: paired 2000-draw cluster bootstrap over group proxies for MAE and tasks for ranking; descriptive conditional intervals
diagnostics: selected requested/effective ranks, shrinkage choices, unavailable ranking-selection folds, optimizer convergence, primary close-gap ranking, paired deltas versus AnchorMean/OriginalLatent/Additive
interpretation: all three predeclared methods and null results retained; no choosing a test-set winner as an unbiased new discovery; no new robot-policy training, inference, rollouts, paid APIs, physical validation, or unseen-task claims
